subject: Account locked – need access before payroll run today
body:
Hi,

I entered my password wrong a few times this morning and now my account is locked. I'm the only one in the finance team who can approve today's payroll, and the bank cutoff is at 3 PM.

Can someone unlock it urgently?

Thanks,
Rachel Cohen
Finance Manager
what_it_tests: Basic: login issue with real deadline

subject: Invoice export creates an empty PDF
body:
Hello,

When I click "Export to PDF" on any invoice, the file downloads but it's completely blank.

For now I'm using the browser's "Print to PDF" as a workaround, but it's slow when I have 20+ invoices.

Best,
Tom Shapiro

subject: CRM extremely slow since last night's update
body:
Hi team,

Since the update last night, every page in the CRM takes about 30 seconds to load. Searching for a customer sometimes times out completely.

We can still work, just very slowly. The whole sales team is affected.

Daniel R.
Sales Team Lead

subject: No internet in Haifa branch – entire office offline
body:
URGENT

The whole Haifa office has had no internet connection since 8:30. None of the 15 computers can connect, the phones are down too, and we have customers waiting at the counter.

We already restarted the router twice.

Yossi, Branch Manager

subject: Laptop battery looks swollen
body:
Hi,

I noticed my laptop doesn't close properly anymore and the bottom case is bulging. It also gets very hot when charging.

Is it safe to keep using it? I have a lot of work this week.

Noa Ben-David

subject: Setup request for new employee starting next Sunday
body:
Hello,

We have a new team member, Amit Levi, starting next Sunday.

Could you please prepare a laptop with Microsoft Office, the VPN client, and access to the shared Marketing folder?

Thank you,
Shira Katz
HR Department

subject: Customer data duplicated and some records missing after sync
body:
Hi,

After yesterday's sync, our customer report shows many customers twice, and about 40 customers from last month are completely gone.

We use this report for the board meeting on Thursday. I'm worried we've lost data.

Moshe Avraham
Operations

subject: Adding 3 user licenses + question about our invoice
body:
Hi Heido,

We're growing and would like to add 3 more user licenses.

Also, could you explain the "Service Fee" line on our October invoice? I couldn't find it in our contract.

No rush, thanks!
Lior Mizrahi
Office Manager

subject: לא מצליחה להתחבר אחרי איפוס סיסמה
body:

איפסתי את הסיסמה לפי הקישור שקיבלתי במייל, אבל כשאני מנסה להתחבר עם הסיסמה החדשה אני מקבלת הודעה "Invalid credentials".

ניסיתי כבר מדפדפן אחר וזה לא עזר.

תודה,
מיכל

subject: I think I clicked a phishing link
body:
Hi,

I got an email that looked like it was from our bank and asked me to "verify my account". I clicked the link and entered my work email and password before I realized it looked suspicious.

Nothing strange has happened yet, but I wanted to report it.

Gal Peretz
Accounting
